secondary_treatment: subtle technical-drawing diagram language for anatomical features and unusual adaptations

negative_constraints: no photorealism, no 3D CGI, no anime, no painterly rendering, no watercolor wash, no screen-print halftones, no collage cut edges, no dense engraving crosshatching, no neon-pop palette, no heavy gradients, no dramatic cinematic realism, no grotesque horror treatment, no decorative typography, no labels or readable text inside illustrations, and no copying of the reference image's people, campus imagery, objects, logos, text, or exact composition
